title: V4Rule
description: A rule defines a data flow pattern used to categorize vulnerability and attack types. Some common rules are sql-injection, ssrf, and reflected-xss.

description.description: Description of the vulnerability type the rule is checking for.

category.description: Rule category. Rules are grouped into categories that have similar characteristics.

severity.description: Default severity to assign for vulnerabilities violating the rule. This can be customized by your organization.

confidence.description: Level of confidence that vulnerabilities detected by this rule are true positives.

likelihood.description: Likelihood of vulnerabilities detected by this rule to actually be exploited.

impact.description: The level of negative impact an exploit of this vulnerability would have.

cweUrl.description: Link to information about the CWE this rule addresses.

owaspUrl.description: Link to OWASP information about the vulnerability this rule addresses. QUESTION--Should these two be named Url, Uri or Link?
